question: What does the engine check on a hook-returned tree before drawing it, and can the walk run unchanged in the product?
answer: Yes. Eur walks the tree with its node/depth/element/prop/surface/dialog rules, answering the first problem or reporting measured rows; twenty verbatim blocks (8,449 units) include the walk, lur, the hover-scope check and the tables it reads. The seam exposes validateDrawnTree and the source limits; no gno caller is wired yet.

semantics.walk: root must be an element; text children may not hold control characters; non-nodes and unknown elements fail; block elements fail inside inline; surface membership is checked; per-element validators, sibling key scope and lur's hover/group/client rules run; Button children are strings/Text only; Link props go through sno; prop names/kinds/sQt rules and layout names around the dialog are checked; Raster cells and Image bytes are bounded
semantics.dialog: component B3e (AskUserQuestion) requires exactly one engine node, forbids Markdown, layout props and hover display/position props around it, and bounds measured rows
semantics.reporting: the first problem is returned; Box key problems (control characters, duplicates) reach note() without failing the tree; measured(rows) is called when the tree validates

product.caller: none yet; the gno pipeline wiring remains the last slice
